design_notes: The flight home lands Thursday 16:00 (Emirates) or 20:05 (Delta), and work at headquarters resumes Monday 08:00, more than 24 hours later; on the way out, the workshop began 13 hours after landing. 'arrival at the destination and/or return to headquarters' (432-433) either lets the met destination test carry the trip (business) or applies the headquarters test to the flight home (economy).
